Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1213 PM EST Tue Nov 17 2026
 

- Dry weather during the week with above normal temperatures.

- Next chance for precipitation arrives this weekend with a cold 
frontal passage.

&&

.AVIATION...

Center of high pressure remains parked over Ohio this afternoon 
before it begins to migrate slightly east tonight. Steady southwest 
wind near or below 10 kt continues to advect in mild and dry air 
with clear skies below 20 kft agl through tonight. Another favorable 
night for radiational cooling brings potential for shallow fog 
development early Wednesday morning. Will start with a prevailing 
MVFR mention for the Metro Detroit TAFs where the gradient will 
remain the weakest. Farther north toward MBS and FNT, more 
persistent southwest gradient wind looks to keep the boundary layer 
slightly more mixed and lower confidence exists for visibility 
reduction. The complicating factor will be coverage and thickness of 
cirrus that moves in overnight - this may end up hampering fog 
development.

For DTW...Enough confidence for shallow fog Wednesday morning to 
include an MVFR mention with this TAF package.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* None.
